verifier_reason: test_outputs.py::test_filter_blocks_xss: The test failed in the call phase due to an assertion error

items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Function names are clear (is_dangerous_url, sanitize_tag, find_tag_end), but there are no docstrings. The tokenizer uses single-letter names in its core logic (`m`, `q`, `n`, `c`), and long branches such as the attribute parsing in sanitize_tag have almost no comments.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: filter_html_once is about 95 lines in one monolithic tokenizer loop. The html.unescape loop (`for _ in range(3): curr = html.unescape(prev)`) is copy-pasted three times. The scheme list is a local inside a function, not a named module constant. sanitize_tag is about 60 lines.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: It checks argv, sets an explicit encoding and uses with-blocks. There is no handling for a missing or unreadable file. Magic constants include `range(3)` and `range(10)`. An unclosed `<script>` without src sets `i = n`, which silently drops the rest of the document.

items.name: Obfuscated vectors neutralised
items.evidence: Handles on* attributes in any case, slash separators, entity and control-character URL normalisation, srcdoc and meta refresh. It never removes iframe, object, embed or base elements themselves; it only strips their URLs. The hidden test_filter_blocks_xss failed.

items.name: Minimal edits on dirty documents
items.name_zh: 含恶意内容的文档仅做最小修改
items.evidence: The offset tokenizer keeps the original bytes, quoting and attribute order. But is_dangerous_url runs on every attribute value, so benign text such as title="javascript: guide" gets stripped, and an unclosed script deletes everything after it. The hidden test_clean_html_unchanged failed.
